tauri-plugin-wallpaper 4.0.0

Copyright (c) Meslzy

The vendored plugin is distributed under the MIT License. The source package
and its readme are included here so the Windows desktop attachment remains
compatible with the Windows handle API used by this Reset build.

Reset changes: Windows bindings updated to 0.62; SetParent checks a freshly
cleared last-error value so a successful NULL previous parent is accepted.
Forwarded mouse messages retain MK_* button and modifier flags, including
press/release transitions, so WebView2 pointer capture supports desktop drags.
Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/inputdev/wm-lbuttondown
